body: Confirmed: a local checkpoint of the exact frozen qualified 388-file package bytes is appropriate; preserve current graph work unstaged and do not push/tag/publish on my authority. Completed non-package scope you may include: docs/FEATURE_SPEC.md, docs/ESTIMATOR_ACCEPTANCE.md, docs/QUALIFICATION_0.2.0.md, docs/DESIGNER_ACCEPTANCE.md, docs/SUBSET_DESIGNER.md, docs/QUALIFICATION_DESIGNER.md, docs/evidence/release-a/, docs/evidence/designer-v1/, tools/designer/. Release A and designer archive receipts intentionally retain their distinct source hashes. Exclude graph-v1 fixtures/evidence, R/graph.R, graph docs/tests/man, and newer graph namespace lines from that checkpoint. Your final source-dir/work-name check utility is fine to include with its own validation.
